page.layout: One page of text: a single table with running head at top, column headings, and 32 rows. Columns left to right: Anni Iul., Lit.dom., Nabonasari, Feriæ, a middle column of dash annotations (—7 Iul. etc.), and Christi. Page number 414 at head. Small figure 263 at bottom right.

main_text.l: Anni Iul. Lit.dom. Nabonasari. Feriæ. Christi

page.notes: Figure 263 at bottom right is printed but its meaning is unclear; left out of page_number. The old-style numerals (e.g. 186, 187) and the dash annotations are copied as printed. A faint pencil mark near row 245 is handwriting and was left out. Printed page numbers are read from the scan at normal size.
